issues.on_page: Line 48 Water: General Fund column 26,986.67 (Water Fund column 13,513.55)
issues.issue: Water utility spending printed in the General Fund column is kept governmental under the column rule. Defensible, but it is a business-type row paid by a governmental fund while Water transfers 36,129.19 to General. The user may want to confirm the treatment.
The business-type 'Local Receipts: Other' is probably utility user charges, but the form prints it as Other, so 'other' (category_decision) is defensible.
